job.job_description:
Data Engineer (AWS + CI/CD + SAP Native Focus)

Role Summary

We are hiring a Data Engineer (+7 years) with strong expertise in AWS-based data engineering and CI/CD, combined with deep experience in SAP Native systems (HANA, BW, ABAP). This role focuses on building scalable pipelines, ensuring deployment reliability, and managing backend data integration.

Key Responsibilities

Design and build scalable data pipelines on AWS (S3, Glue, Lambda, Redshift/EMR as applicable).

Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for data workflows (GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps).

Extract and integrate data from SAP HANA, BW, and ABAP layers.

Ensure automated deployments, version control, and environment stability.

Monitor pipelines, perform incident resolution, and root cause analysis.

Enforce data governance, security, and performance optimization.

Core Skills

Strong Data Engineering (Python, SQL, Spark optional)

Deep experience with AWS data stack

Strong CI/CD and DevOps practices

Strong SAP Native knowledge (HANA, BW, ABAP extraction logic)

Experience in pipeline orchestration and monitoring



Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
job.location: Noida, Gurugram, Bengaluru, Pune, Chennai, Mumbai
